# QR encoder attribution

This directory contains the QRCode for JavaScript encoder by Kazuhiko Arase,
with the Node compatibility/refactoring distributed in `qrcode-terminal` and
bundled with the installed npm CLI. The original MIT notices are preserved in
the source headers. The distributor's complete Apache-2.0/MIT notice is retained
in `LICENSE`. Source: https://github.com/gtanner/qrcode-terminal/tree/master/vendor/QRCode

The encoder is used locally/server-side. QR images are generated from the
configured public website origin; no third-party QR generation service receives
shop credentials or customer data.
